description: Returns Pluggy's transaction category taxonomy (GET /categories), cached for the adapter session. Each entry has `id` (the categoryId used by openfinance_update_transaction_category), `description` (English), `descriptionTranslated` (Portuguese — prefer this for pt-BR users), `parentId` and `parentDescription` (the tree parent). Single aggregated response — no batch ids.
name: openfinance_list_categories
